name: 65203 · Columbia, MO
findings: ZIP 65203 (Columbia) has 317 nonprofit organizations. 168 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65203 (Columbia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 65203 (Columbia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
